content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

§§ 8.2–8.3 already sit at our preferred RENEWAL position:

- **12-month renewal terms** — "renews for successive twelve-month periods".
- **Customer opt-out on 30 days' notice** — "unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal".
- **60-day Vendor reminder** — "Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand", plus a Customer-favourable extension of the opt-out deadline if the reminder is not sent.
- **Uplift cap** — § 8.3 limits increases to "the lesser of the increase in the United States Consumer Price Index ... during the preceding twelve months and three percent", with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.

§ 8.1's three-year master term is a fixed initial term, not an automatic multi-year renewal, so it does not trigger walk-away territory. No redline proposed.
